name: Idk how to title this one
source:
"Idk how to title this one" is a kinetic visual novel set in current day europe following a golden retriever named Daniel on his "educational journey".  Preparing for school, dealing with stress that comes with it, reconnecting with old pals, meeting new ones, doing mandatory school activities. 

[From [url=https://mintsquared2.itch.io/idk-how-to-title-this-one]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Idk how to title this one》是一部以当代欧洲为舞台的单线视觉小说，讲述了金毛寻回犬丹尼尔的“求学之旅”：为开学做准备、应对随之而来的课业压力、与老朋友重拾联系、结交新伙伴，以及参加学校强制要求的各项活动。

[摘自[url=https://mintsquared2.itch.io/idk-how-to-title-this-one]itch.io[/url]]
